newsitem.title: BELGIUM: France says wants EU treaty finished on time-source.
newsitem.headline: France says wants EU treaty finished on time-source.

text.p: France's new government told its European Union partners on Friday that it wants negotiations on a new treaty to be completed at the EU summit in Amsterdam on June 16 and 17, a treaty negotiator said.
Some EU countries have questioned whether the election of the Socialists in France might mean a delay in the treaty in order to give them time to prepare new positions.

The message was delivered to negotiators by France's ambassador to the EU, Pierre de Boissieu, who has been representing Paris in the treaty talks since former European Affairs Minister Michel Barnier was replaced.
"Pierre de Boissieu confirmed the government's intention to get a deal in Amsterdam," the negotiator said, requesting anonymity. "There will be an agreement."
The EU wants to seal a new treaty at the summit in order to clear the way for enlargement into eastern Europe.
